method: Paired saved-input experiment. Four new comparison calls with identical drafts and inventories; only appended field guidance changes. One treatment per saved control, no fresh original-prompt controls. Direct revisable source review, no automatic corrections.
checks: Retain detection of rejected nonconsecutive-month rule.
Retain useful summary/scope findings but distinguish meaning preserved in logic_text from total omission.
Credit grouped duties jointly rather than require duplicate parent records.
Recognize alternative_quotes as components with AND/OR controlled by choice_text.
Do not require optional relationship enrichment.
Avoid new substantive false alarms; retain recommendations/descriptive force and scope.
Check consistent reciprocal links and covered/partial judgments; no swallowed parsing failures.
Record comparative token usage, findings and remaining inventory defects.
